general_rules.rule: Use of all vagaries tables is optional.
When a vagary result is implausible or irrelevant, the Judge should re-roll, alter the event to make it plausible, or treat it as a no_vagary result.
These rules add bookkeeping and complexity.

shared_unit_scale_rules.rule: When a vagary causes a leader to gain or lose units, use battalion-sized units if the leader rules a duchy or principality, brigade-sized units if the leader rules a kingdom or empire, and company-sized units in all other cases.

trigger.condition: Roll each month that a leader is recruiting mercenaries, conscripts, militia, or vassal troops.

result.name: alliance_offered
result.rule: Select an allied neighboring domain or realm of approximately the same size as the leader's own.
If no such domain or realm exists, re-roll this vagary.
The ally supports the leader in war by sending half its garrison.

result.name: all_quiet
result.rule: No vagary occurs this month.

result.name: bidding_war
result.rule: Increase the cost of finding and hiring mercenaries by 2d4 x 100%.
Mercenary wages do not change.

result.name: bold_captain
result.rule: A talented commander emerges from the army's ranks and serves the leader.
Base morale score is +1 instead of -2.

result.name: brigands
result.rule: Renegade mercenaries harass the realm.
The brigands may be treated as an independent enemy army for Domains at War purposes.

army_composition.commander: 5th level fighter with command characteristics of a mercenary captain
9th level fighter with command characteristics of a mercenary colonel
army_composition.support_chance: 50% chance of one mage of level 8+1d2

result.name: commander_casualty

procedure.step: Make a saving throw versus Death for each commander in the army, starting with the physically oldest commander.
The first commander to fail dies from accident, illness, or similar circumstances.
If no commander fails, the event has no effect.

result.rule: The dead commander may be restored through restore life and limb or similar magic.

result.name: commerce_disrupted
result.rule: The leader's largest urban settlement is treated as one market class smaller.

result.name: commerce_improves
result.rule: The leader's largest urban settlement is treated as one market class larger.

procedure.step: Immediately after receiving wages, check each mercenary unit in the army, starting with the unit with the lowest morale.
Make a loyalty roll for each checked unit.
The first unit with a result of Resignation or Enmity deserts the day after it is next paid.
If no unit fails, the event has no effect.

result.name: foreign_legion
result.rule: A mercenary unit from a foreign realm offers service.
The unit type should be one not generally available to the leader.
If hired, the unit suffers a -1 penalty to base morale due to language and cultural difficulties.

procedure.step: Determine mercenary type by rolling on the Follower Type and Equipment by Class table, using the army leader's class.
There is a 25% chance the mercenaries are veterans.

result.name: resignation

procedure.step: Make a loyalty roll for each commander in the army, starting with the commander with the lowest morale.
The first commander with a result of Resignation or Enmity unexpectedly resigns.
If no commander fails, the event has no effect.

result.rule: The Judge determines a plausible reason for the resignation.

result.name: soldier_of_fortune
result.rule: An experienced soldier offers to serve the leader as a henchman.

procedure.step: Generate the soldier of fortune using the NPC Parties rules in ACKS.
Set the soldier's base level to two levels lower than the leader's level.

result.rule: The soldier expects pay and position appropriate to class and level.

result.name: stout_recruits
result.rule: Twice as many conscripts and militia recruited this month qualify for advanced training.

result.name: surplus_sellswords
result.rule: The crop of mercenaries available in the leader's realm is doubled.
Mercenary wages do not increase during this time, regardless of how many are hired.

result.name: tribute
result.rule: The leader gains gold equal to the lesser of one month's wages for his army or 1gp per family in his overall realm.

result.name: war_declared
result.rule: Select a rival neighboring domain or realm of approximately the same size as the leader's own.
If no such domain or realm exists, re-roll this vagary.
The rival has a full complement of vassal troops and attacks as swiftly as possible.

result.name: war_profiteers
result.rule: Increase the cost of artillery ammunition, armor, mounts, supplies, and weapons by 10%.
Each additional time this vagary is rolled, prices increase by an additional 10%.

result.name: weak_recruits
result.rule: All conscripts and militia recruited this month qualify only as light infantry.
This overrides the normal rule that 50% of conscripts and militia qualify to be heavy infantry or archers.

trigger.condition: Roll each week after checking for supply when an army is on campaign in enemy territory or out of garrison for more than one month.

siege_modifier.rule: During sieges, roll twice per week and use the lower, worse result.

result.name: all_quiet
result.rule: No vagary occurs this week.

result.name: artillery_magazine
result.rule: The army discovers 1d4 different artillery units cached from prior campaigns.
Each discovered artillery unit has 1d6 days of ammunition.

result.name: brigands
result.rule: Until the brigands are dealt with, the army's supply costs increase by 10%.
Until the brigands are dealt with, the army suffers -1 on reconnaissance rolls.
The brigands may be treated as an independent enemy army for Domains at War purposes.

army_composition.commander: 5th level fighter with command characteristics of a mercenary captain
9th level fighter with command characteristics of a mercenary colonel
army_composition.support_chance: 50% chance of one mage of level 8+1d2

result.name: camp_followers
result.rule: The army gains camp followers.
While they remain, the army's movement rate is reduced by one-third.
Enemy spies gain a +2 bonus to conduct hijinks against the army while the followers remain.
If the army leader drives off the camp followers, it counts as a morale calamity.

result.name: commander_casualty

procedure.step: Make a saving throw versus Death for each commander in the army, starting with the physically oldest commander.
The first commander to fail dies.
If no commander fails, the event has no effect.

result.rule: The dead commander may be restored through restore life and limb or similar magic.

procedure.step: Make a loyalty roll for each commander in the relevant army, starting with the commander with the lowest morale.
The first commander with a result of Resignation or Enmity becomes a defector.
If no commander fails, the event has no effect.
If an opposing army is within one week's march, the defector immediately defects and brings the units under his command to the opposing army.
Otherwise, the defector feigns loyalty until an opportune moment.

result.name: defection_enemy
result.rule: Use the defection procedure, but the defector comes from the enemy army to the current army.

procedure.step: Make a loyalty roll for each unit in the army, starting with the unit with the lowest morale.
The first unit with a result of Resignation or Enmity deserts.
If no unit fails, the event has no effect.
If an enemy force is within one week's march, the deserters join the opposing army.
Otherwise, the deserters disband and go home.

result.name: disease
result.rule: This represents a major epidemic, not ordinary background illness.

procedure.step: Roll 1d100 on the disease_type table to determine the disease.
Each unit makes a saving throw versus Death, applying any disease save bonus.
If a unit succeeds, it avoids serious illness.
If a unit fails, it becomes diseased for the listed duration and cannot move or fight.
At the end of the duration, a diseased unit recovers unless it failed by the disease's listed death threshold or failed on a natural 1.
A unit that dies is removed from play.

result.rule: Saving throws for disease should be made secretly by the Judge so commanders do not know which diseased units will recover.

treatment_rules.rule: Diseased units can be cured by divine spellcasters and/or healers.
treatment_rules.rate: One 9th level divine spellcaster cures one sickened unit in one week.
Two 7th-8th level divine spellcasters cure one sickened unit in one week.
Three 6th level divine spellcasters or chirugeons cure one sickened unit in one week.
Nine physickers cure one sickened unit in one week.
treatment_rules.rule: If the number of casters or healers is greater or lesser, adjust the cure rate proportionately.

result.name: friendly_lord
result.rule: A local lord offers to become a vassal or sub-vassal of the army leader.
The lord offers use of his stronghold as a supply base.
The lord pays tribute equal to his monthly income.
In return, the lord expects protection from looting, conquest, and pillage by the army.

result.name: friendly_peasants
result.rule: The army gains +2 on reconnaissance rolls for the next week.
This benefit is lost if the army requisitions or loots supplies from any domains during that week.

result.name: good_omen
result.rule: Loyalty and morale rolls gain a +1 bonus for the next week.
Add 10 to the army's next roll on the Vagaries of War table.

result.name: good_weather
result.rule: The army's strategic movement rate increases by 33% for the next week.

result.name: ill_omen
result.rule: Loyalty and morale rolls suffer a -1 penalty for the next week.
Subtract 10 from the army's next roll on the Vagaries of War table.

result.name: legendary_leadership
result.rule: The army leader's morale modifier increases by 1.
This benefit is lost if the leader's army is ever defeated in two consecutive battles.

result.name: local_guides
result.rule: If accepted, local guides increase the army's movement rate by 33%.

procedure.step: Determine mercenary type by rolling on the Follower Type and Equipment by Class table, using the leader's class.
There is a 25% chance the mercenaries are veterans.

result.name: ministers
result.rule: 2d6 clerics of level 1d4 join the campaign.
All units in the army gain +1 morale while the ministers remain.
The ministers depart if camp followers are permitted on the campaign or if the army leader acts contrary to their faith.

result.name: plans_discovered
result.rule: The benefiting army learns the opposing army's location, organization, and leadership as if it had scored a major success on a reconnaissance roll.
The benefiting army automatically wins the next initiative roll against the opposing army.

result.name: bad_weather
result.rule: This result creates severe weather lasting 1d4 weeks.
If severe weather is rolled again while severe weather is already ongoing, add the durations together.

procedure.step: Cross-index the terrain of the 24-mile hex occupied by the army with the current season on the severe_weather_conditions table.
Read the first line as the temperature condition.
Read the second line as the atmospheric condition.
If an entry gives only a percentage chance for severe weather, apply that chance; if severe weather does not occur, use mild temperature or calm atmosphere instead.
Apply all weather effects cumulatively.

effect_rules.rule: Cold: strategic movement rate halved; 10% chance each week of a disease vagary due to exposure.
Hot: strategic movement rate halved; supply cost increased 25%; out-of-supply penalties doubled; mud cannot form.
Rainy: strategic movement rate halved; reconnaissance rolls suffer -2; in clear, grass, and scrub terrain, mud halves movement again; 10% chance each week of a disease vagary due to wetness.
Snowy: strategic movement rate halved; reconnaissance rolls suffer -4; 10% chance each week of a disease vagary due to wetness.
Windy: strategic movement rate halved; in barren or desert terrain, reconnaissance rolls suffer -4 due to sandstorms.
All listed weather effects stack cumulatively.

result.name: siege_train_problems

procedure.step: Make a saving throw versus Death for each artillery piece in the army.
If the piece has a siege engineer or artillerist assigned, it saves as a 4th level fighter; otherwise, it saves as a normal man.
On a failed save, the artillery piece is broken and reduced to 0 shp.

result.rule: Broken artillery may be repaired as a construction project.
For repairs, wood repairs at 5 shp per gp of construction rate.

result.name: spy_caught_enemy

procedure.step: If one or more enemy spies are infiltrated into the army, choose one randomly.
If no spies are infiltrated, the army has caught a soldier who had just become a turncoat.
The captured spy may be interrogated.

result.rule: The spy knows 1d4 common pieces of information about the opposing army.

result.name: spy_caught_friendly
result.rule: A friendly spy is caught and killed by the enemy.
No further expanded procedure is provided beyond the table entry.

result.name: supply_boon
result.rule: The army is automatically in supply this week.
The army leader does not pay supply cost this week.
The army's market class is raised by 1 for equipment availability this month.

result.name: supply_problems
result.rule: The army is out of supply this week.
Out-of-supply consequences are -1 hp per day, -1 to attack throws and damage rolls per day, and a morale calamity.

result.name: treacherous_guides
result.rule: If accepted, the guides increase the army's movement rate by 33% for one week.
The enemy gains one free hijink.
The enemy gains a +1 bonus on reconnaissance rolls.

result.name: war_profiteers
result.rule: Increase the cost of artillery ammunition, armor, mounts, supplies, and weapons by 10% for the duration of the campaign.
Each additional time this vagary is rolled, prices increase by an additional 10%.

trigger.condition: Each time PCs make a heroic foray during a battle.

procedure.step: Roll 1d4 to determine how many battle vagaries occur during the foray.
For each vagary, roll 1d100 on the vagaries_of_battle table.
Re-roll results that do not make sense in the context of the battle.

trigger.definition: Whenever battlefield is referenced, it means the local area where the foray is fought, not necessarily the entire battlefield.

result.name: ambush
result.rule: PCs are surprised for the first round of the foray.
The distance between the heroes and each group of foes is halved.

result.name: battle_standards
result.rule: Double the BR staked for the foray.
All creatures on either side gain +2 to morale rolls.

result.name: blood_and_mud
result.rule: Any creature that rolls a natural 1 on an attack throw or saving throw falls prone.

procedure.step: 1d4 rounds after the foray begins, make an attack throw with target value 18+ against each creature in the foray.
Ignore armor for this attack.
A hit means the creature is in the blast radius of a catapult stone.
The struck creature takes 4d6 damage unless it succeeds on a saving throw versus Blast.

result.name: booby_traps
result.rule: There is one battlefield trap per point of BR staked.
The typical trap is a concealed pit filled with sharpened stakes.

procedure.step: A moving PC has a 1 in 6 chance to move into an undiscovered battlefield trap.
If the trap is not detected, normally requiring a proficiency throw of 18+, the PC falls 10 feet for 1d6 damage.
The PC then lands on 1d4 spikes, each dealing 1d6 damage.

result.name: calm_amidst_the_storm
result.rule: No vagary occurs.

result.name: culmination
result.rule: In each of the first 5 rounds of the foray, an additional 10 HD of creatures join per point of BR staked.

result.name: debris
result.rule: Creatures that run or charge must make a saving throw versus Paralysis or fall prone halfway through their move.

result.name: debris_dangerous
result.rule: Creatures that run or charge must make a saving throw versus Paralysis or suffer 1d4 damage.

result.name: debris_heavy
result.rule: Movement rates are halved.
Charging and running are not permitted.
Thieves and similar characters gain a +2 bonus to proficiency throws to hide because of ample cover.

procedure.step: 1d4 rounds after the foray begins, deserters arrive.
The deserters belong to whichever side has fewer HD present in the foray.
There are 10 HD of deserters per point of BR staked.
They enter from their enemy's side and try to escape to their own side.
They attack anyone who blocks their escape.
PCs and NPCs from the deserters' side may attempt to rally them back into the fight with reaction rolls.

result.name: fire
result.rule: Each round, all participants must save versus Blast or take 1d4 fire damage.
Line of sight is reduced to 30 feet.

result.name: fog_and_smoke
result.rule: Line of sight is reduced to 30 feet for the duration of the foray.

result.name: high_ground
result.rule: Defending creatures gain +1 AC and +1 to attack throws.

result.name: marauders

procedure.step: 1d4 rounds after the foray begins, brigands arrive.
There are 10 HD of brigands per point of BR staked.

result.rule: The brigands attack weak and damaged creatures and steal carried equipment.

result.name: monsters

procedure.step: 1d4 rounds after the foray begins, monsters arrive.
There are 10 HD of monsters per point of BR staked.
The Judge may choose the monster type or determine it randomly from battlefield terrain.

result.rule: The monsters attack weak and damaged creatures.

result.name: piles_of_dead
result.rule: Movement rates are halved.
Charging and running are not permitted.
Corpses may be animated by necromancers.
Thieves and similar characters gain a +2 bonus to proficiency throws to hide because of ample cover.
All creatures suffer -2 to morale rolls.

result.name: reinforcements_enemy
result.rule: Use the reinforcements procedure with the joining side being the enemy.

result.name: reinforcements_friendly
result.rule: Use the reinforcements procedure with the joining side being friendly.

procedure.step: 1d4 rounds after the foray begins, additional troops join from one side.
10 HD of creatures join per point of BR staked.

result.name: scattered_bodies
result.rule: There are 1d10 x 10 bodies scattered across the battlefield.
Corpses may be animated by necromancers.
Creatures that run or charge must save versus Paralysis or fall prone halfway through their move.
All creatures suffer -1 to morale rolls.

procedure.step: 1d4 rounds after the foray begins, make an attack throw against each creature in the foray.
Use target value 15+, modified by AC.
A hit deals 1d6 damage.

wishes_and_warfare.rule: Instead of using miracle or wish for more traditional effects, a caster may use either ritual spell to bring about any desired vagary of recruitment, vagary of war, or vagary of battle.
The chosen vagary may benefit the caster's army or harm an enemy army.
A miracle or wish may also undo or avoid an undesirable vagary.

source_notes.note: The Vagaries of War table prints bad_weather, while the expanded rules present the mechanics under severe_weather; this summary treats them as the same result.
The Vagaries of War table prints artillery_magazine, while the expanded rules use artillery_cache; this summary treats them as the same result.
The printed Vagaries of War die ranges overlap at 32 for war_profiteers and siege_train_problems; the overlap is preserved as printed.
The friendly spy caught result is named in the table, but only the enemy spy caught version receives expanded index text.
The battle table prints separate friendly and enemy reinforcements results, while the index provides one shared reinforcements procedure; this summary applies that shared procedure to either side.
